contentPattern.structure: Key/value rows (value = default, optional third cell = help text): Home value, Mortgage balance, Cash-out amount, Loan terms (comma list, e.g. 30-Year Fixed, 15-Year Fixed), Interest rate, LTV (default 80), Minimum cash-out (default 15000), Closing cost (% of loan, default 2), Button, Result title. Non-key rows before the first key row render above the calculator, rows after render under the form

usage: Home equity line of credit and rates pages
reuseGuidance: All computation is client-side; no data leaves the browser.
